plainText:
True Identity and the Totem Pokémon of Brooklet Hill (Japanese: 正体！！せせらぎの丘のぬし！ Identity!! The of Brooklet Hill!) is the ninth chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
==Major events==
 
is tasked by Lana to defeat the Totem Pokémon of Brooklet Hill.
Sun and Lana head off to Brooklet Hill, Kiawe goes to work, while and Mallow go to Lush Jungle to collect Berry samples.
At the Dimensional Research Lab, Professor Kukui learns from Professor Burnet that Nebby is a Legendary Pokémon named .
At Brooklet Hill, Sun befriends a wild , which he nicknames Quarter and asks to help search for the Totem Pokémon.
After scares Quarter out of anger, it summons other Wishiwashi to form a Wishiwashi, the Totem of Brooklet Hill.
At Lush Jungle, Moon and Mallow witness in battle with a .
